gen-gf-baumans-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office keeps its curves open-ended and modern, a quiet counterweight to the heavy-handed heading. Baumans draws every stroke at a single thickness for a distinctive look, while Ysabeau Office sticks to being a plain sans you can just read.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC reads modern and businesslike, its c gaping wide at any size. Baumans stays commanding above it, every stroke a constant nib width, and the text below just keeps rolling along.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zalando-sans: Approachable is the first word for Zalando Sans, whose curves all end open, set under a Baumans heading that draws every stroke like a fixed-width stencil brush. Paragraphs flow smoothly, without anything snagging.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Wide, spaced and tidy: Zalando Sans Expanded keeps its c tips well apart beneath Baumans, whose strokes hold one thickness like a drawn cable. Lines of text feel wide and unhurried.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded opens the mouths of its c, e and s under a Baumans heading whose round letters have rims matching their stems. Its sharpest quality is that contrast.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Baumans has a round bowl whose outline never swells or thins. ZCOOL XiaoWei, with a mild stress in its o and e, carries a longer passage smoothly, with no ink pooling at the turns.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Baumans leads with a commanding crescent-wrench c. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique follows in a plain sans with a smooth path around every bend, and body text looks best at a modest size.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Bold crescent-wrench curves up top, then calm below. Zen Kaku Gothic New is a sans with open curves and no hairlines or swells, so give it a comfortable size and let it breathe.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Commanding Baumans draws every stroke at one thickness. Zen Maru Gothic, a sans whose bowls never close up, reads like following a single thread, so the two sit together with a firm lead and a smooth follow.
gen-gf-baumans-ibm-plex-sans: Stiff, technical and sharp at the top: Baumans draws a c like a crescent wrench opened wide. IBM Plex Sans gives every bowl a wide channel, so the text beneath feels approachable next to the heavy heading.
